results.title: Degree Program Reviews; Graduate Thresholds; Commission Approval to Continue

triage.rationale: Imposes a direct duty on state educational institutions to request commission approval before continuing degree programs that fall below statutory graduate thresholds, and to eliminate programs where approval is refused.

obligation.summary: Request Commission for Higher Education approval to continue any degree program whose three-year average graduate count falls below the statutory threshold for its award level.
obligation.verbatim_quote: the state educational institution must request approval from the commission to continue the degree program
obligation.responsible_unit: Office of the Executive Vice President for University Academic Affairs
obligation.unit_rationale: The statute places the duty on the 'state educational institution' and concerns continuation of academic degree programs, which sits with academic affairs.

routed_obligations.route_reason: All checks passed; combined confidence 0.95. Filed to Office of the Executive Vice President for University Academic Affairs.

obligation.summary: Eliminate any under-threshold degree program, and the costs associated with it, where the Commission declines to approve continuation.
obligation.verbatim_quote: If the commission does not grant approval under subsection (a), the state educational institution must eliminate
obligation.responsible_unit: Office of the Executive Vice President for University Academic Affairs
obligation.unit_rationale: Duty falls on the institution and concerns program discontinuation, an academic affairs function.

routed_obligations.route_reason: All checks passed; combined confidence 0.93. Filed to Office of the Executive Vice President for University Academic Affairs.

obligation.summary: Maintain three-year rolling average graduate counts for every degree program so threshold status can be determined.
obligation.verbatim_quote: average number of students who graduate over the immediately preceding three (3) years is fewer than
obligation.unit_rationale: The threshold test depends on graduate counts, which are produced and certified by institutional analytics.

verdict.objection: The quoted span states the threshold test, not an express duty to maintain rolling averages. The monitoring duty is a reasonable operational inference but is not commanded by this text.

routed_obligations.route_reason: Verifier confidence 0.62 below 0.75.

results.title: Board of Trustees Tenure Review Criteria; Institutional Disciplinary Policy

triage.rationale: Directs the board of trustees of an institution to conduct five-year post-tenure reviews against enumerated criteria, adopt a disciplinary policy, and submit its process to the commission for higher education.

obligation.summary: Review each tenured faculty member against the five statutory criteria within five years of tenure and every five years thereafter.
obligation.verbatim_quote: Not later than five (5) years after the date that a faculty member is granted tenure by an institution and not later than every five (5) years thereafter, the board of trustees of an institution shall review and determine whether the faculty member has met the following criteria
obligation.deadline_text: Not later than five (5) years after tenure is granted, and every five (5) years thereafter
obligation.unit_rationale: The statute names 'the board of trustees of an institution' as the actor.

routed_obligations.route_reason: All checks passed; combined confidence 0.97. Filed to Board of Trustees.

obligation.summary: Certify the determination when the board finds a faculty member has met the criteria.
obligation.verbatim_quote: If the board determines a faculty member meets the criteria, the board shall certify that determination.
obligation.unit_rationale: Statute names the board as the certifying actor.

routed_obligations.route_reason: All checks passed; combined confidence 0.94. Filed to Board of Trustees.

obligation.summary: Adopt a disciplinary policy specifying the actions available when a tenured faculty member fails to meet one or more criteria.
obligation.verbatim_quote: The institution shall adopt a disciplinary policy establishing actions including termination, demotion, salary reduction, or other disciplinary action
obligation.unit_rationale: Duty is on 'the institution' and concerns employment discipline, which HR owns in partnership with academic affairs.

routed_obligations.route_reason: All checks passed; combined confidence 0.94. Filed to IU Human Resources.

obligation.summary: Review and renew or amend the post-tenure review process and any board-established criteria at least every five years.
obligation.verbatim_quote: The board shall, at least every five (5) years, review and renew or amend the review process and any criteria established under subsection (a)(5).
obligation.unit_rationale: Statute names the board.

routed_obligations.route_reason: All checks passed; combined confidence 0.95. Filed to Board of Trustees.

obligation.summary: Submit the post-tenure review process and criteria to the Commission for Higher Education each time they are reviewed, renewed, or amended.
obligation.verbatim_quote: The board shall submit to the commission for higher education the process and criteria each time they are reviewed, renewed, or amended.
obligation.unit_rationale: Statute names the board as the submitting party; the trigger is any revision of the process.

results.title: Complaint Procedure; Institution Report; Commission for Higher Education Report

triage.rationale: Creates a cluster of institutional duties: establish and publicise a complaint procedure, refer and surface complaints, and file an annual report with the commission for higher education.

obligation.summary: Establish a procedure allowing students and employees to submit complaints that a faculty member is not meeting the statutory criteria.
obligation.verbatim_quote: Establish a procedure that allows both students and employees to submit complaints that a faculty member or person described in section 3(a) of this chapter is not meeting the criteria described in section 2(a)(1) through 2(a)(5) of this chapter.
obligation.unit_rationale: Complaint intake against employees is an HR-owned process at IU.

routed_obligations.route_reason: All checks passed; combined confidence 0.96. Filed to IU Human Resources.

obligation.summary: Publicise the complaint procedure at student orientations, on the institution's website, and during employee onboarding.
obligation.verbatim_quote: Provide information regarding the procedure established under subdivision (1): (A) at student orientations; (B) on the institution's website; and (C) during employee onboarding programs.
obligation.responsible_unit: Office of the Vice President for Student Success, Enrollment and Institutional Effectiveness
obligation.unit_rationale: Two of the three required channels are student orientation and the institutional website, both owned within student success.

routed_obligations.route_reason: All checks passed; combined confidence 0.92. Filed to Office of the Vice President for Student Success, Enrollment and Institutional Effectiveness.

obligation.summary: Refer submitted complaints to appropriate HR professionals and supervisors for consideration in employee reviews and tenure and promotion decisions.

obligation.unit_rationale: The statute names human resource professionals as the recipients.

routed_obligations.route_reason: All checks passed; combined confidence 0.95. Filed to IU Human Resources.

obligation.summary: Make submitted complaints and any relevant documents, summaries, or investigations available to the board of trustees.
obligation.verbatim_quote: Make complaints submitted under subdivision (1) and any relevant documents, summaries, or investigations available to the board of trustees of the institution.
